items.vanilla_en: Is this really how I go out?  I knew we should have never tried to strike out into unknown space like this. But the crew were ready to mutiny if we didn't try for it. Now here we are slowly be pulled into an uncharted planet in the middle of a system not on anyone's charts. Well... anyone but the Va'ruun apparently. Four ships appeared out of nowhere as soon as we arrived at this strange planet. We had no chance and they knew it. No communication, just opened fire. Looks like that last minute maneuvering lost them, but our engines gave out right after. Now all we can do is wait for gravity to do its thing.

This communication serves to provide a status update on the Kappa site project.

Effective immediately, you are to suspend all activities on the Kappa site project.

Priority is now the reconstruction of our capital. You are ordered to transport as much material as possible to support these efforts.

All personnel are to ensure that, upon departure, maximum feasible quantities of material are transported to support the capital's reconstruction efforts. Additionally, it is imperative that the bunker entrance is in lock down before leaving the site.

Operations on the Kappa site project will resume once the capital's reconstruction is sufficiently underway.

Follow these orders without delay.

The Va'ruun High Council - Lovek Veth'aal
items.vanilla_ko:
이 메시지는 카파 현장 프로젝트의 현 상태를 알리기 위해 발송되었다.

지금 즉시 카파 현장의 모든 프로젝트를 중단할 것을 명한다.

현재 최우선 목표는 수도를 재건하는 것이다. 복구 작업이 빠르게 진행될 수 있도록 원자재를 최대한 많이 운송하도록 하라.

모든 직원들은 현장에서 철수할 때 가능한 한 최대로 원자재를 싣고 돌아와서 수도 재건에 도움이 될 수 있도록 하라. 또한 현장 철수 직전에 벙커 입구를 철저하게 봉쇄할 것을 명한다.

 카파 현장 임무는 수도 복구 작업이 충분히 진행되면 재개될 것이다. 

지체 없이 지시 사항을 수행하라.

바룬 대의회 - 로벡 베타알

It does not have to be like this, however. Instead of fighting bitterly for our own piece of the proverbial pie, we can share it. There's plenty to go around!

I am proposing that we support both of our businesses by referring our customers to each other's shops, and promoting sales together. This way we can share a loyal customer base and allow both businesses to thrive.    

Neon does not have to break us. Competition is good, but cooperation can be even better. I very much hope that you will consider this offer!

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to ask. Thank you!

- Saburo Okadigbo
- Owner and Operator of Neon Mining League

We sneak out when no one's paying attention, drop a corpse that looks like you - I know a guy who used to work at Enhance who does great back alley work on Neon - They won't suspect nothing. You find cover, slip outta there when the coast is clear, hit the meet-up spot, and split the winnings 80-20.

20퍼센트면 너한텐 충분하고도 남을 거야. 총대 매고, 거래하고, 베팅하고, 이 모든 일을 하는 건 나니까. 돈은 내가 벌어다 주는 거라고. 네가 할 일은 그냥 첫 번째 구역을 통과해서, 짐승 몇 마리를 잡다가, 쥐구멍에 숨어 있다가 밤을 버티기만 하면 돼. 누워서 떡 먹기지.

동의만 한다면, 나를 찾아서 이 슬레이트를 돌려줘. 자넨 부자가 될 거야, 친구!
